description.en: Tells whether a depth-of-field level fade (CMND_DEPTHLEVEL_FADE) is still in progress. It takes no camera: there is one such fade at a time. No shipped script calls it; the talk helpers wait a fixed number of frames instead.

true while the fade is in progress, false otherwise.
null if the script system is not ready.

examples.case: Waiting for a depth fade (not found in script_clean/; invented)
